name: record-browser-gif
title_zh: 把浏览器操作录成可直接贴 PR 的 GIF
tagline_zh: 改完界面要给人看效果？不用录屏软件，不用手动裁剪。它用状态抓帧 + 确定性编码，自动产出优化过的 GIF。
tagline_en: Show UI changes without screen-recording hassle—state-based capture and deterministic encoding produce clean.
desc_en: Record browser or Web UI interaction demos as optimized GIFs using the available built-in browser, state-based frame capture, and deterministic encoding, then publish to a dedicated assets branch when the task includes attaching the GIF to a pull request. Use when asked to make, record, or generate a GIF that demonstrates a browser workflow, and for every pull request that changes product-user-vis
why_zh: 不是录屏，是抓状态：只在关键帧采样，体积小、节奏稳。编码参数固定，结果可复现，不会每次生成都不一样。
why_en: Not screen recording—state sampling captures only key frames, yielding compact, steady GIFs. Deterministic encoding means.
limit_zh: 只认内置浏览器，外部浏览器或复杂动效（如 CSS 过渡）会失真；GIF 最长 15 秒，超出自动截断。
limit_en: Only works with the built-in browser; external browsers or CSS transitions may distort. GIFs capped at 15s, auto-truncated. Requires push access to.
